correctness.rationale: The final greedy match is at 1+v_last+3D(v), so absence is exactly D≥k. Removing an endpoint discards its edge; removing a middle letter replaces two forward cyclic gaps by one and shortens their sum by zero or three. With the endpoint deletions this forces D=k and decrease one in every case. Single-letter words are present; length two uses just the single shared endpoint edge. Strict ascents are isolated between weak descents, proving the support bound. Independently built the nine-state matrix from the cyclic-gap test and expanded det(I−T) and the bordered determinant with last column B and last row (−A,0), by recursive row expansion with exact small integer coefficients. These give every displayed denominator and numerator monomial respectively; specializing y=1 and formal division reproduces all ten totals. The frozen certificate and verifier were used as evidence, not executed.

evidence: The earlier Resultary proof states the q²-state transfer and local characterization for all q≥3; set q=3. Kosche et al. give broader greedy-position characterization and an exponential growth result in the even alphabet regime σ≥4. Manea et al. give a path representation in a DAG for general hosts.
